programmes.d: To avoid elimination, our secret celebrity drag queens have to shake their groove things to epic dance anthems.
To stay in the competition, our secret celebrity drag queens need to make it rain as they perform songs about the almighty dollar.
RuPaul pairs the celebrity drag queens with Drag Race royalty: Katya, Eureka, Gottmik, Silky Nutmeg Ganache, Morgan McMichaels, and Violet Chachki.
A shocking twist is revealed that changes the game forever, as our secret celebrities perform their favorite hits from the 90s.
Our celebrity queens celebrate RuPaul's charisma, uniqueness, nerve and talent in style and song.
Don't be a drag just be a queen. Our celebrity drag queens perform songs from the Lady Gaga songbook.
Our finalists go head-to-head and toe-to-toe as they fight to be crowned America's Next Celebrity Drag Superstar.

RuPaul provides running commentary and fun facts about the 14 new queens competing to become America's Next Drag Superstar. But first, they must face their worst fear: a naked runway! With guest judge Kathy Griffin.

RuPaul provides running commentary and fun facts while the queens are challenged to produce a pre-flight safety video for the first airline run by drag queens. With guest judges Olivia Newton-John and Jordin Sparks.
RuPaul provides running commentary and fun facts while the queens "Hamlet it up" in two twisted Shakespeare classics. With guest judges Kat Dennings (2 Broke Girls) and Spice Girl Mel B.
RuPaul provides running commentary and fun facts while the queens sing in parody music videos. With guest judges Jessica Alba (Sin City) and RuPaul's music producer Lucian Piane.

RuPaul provides running commentary and fun facts while the queens' comedy skills are tested as they act as presenters at a glitzy awards show. With comedian Kathy Griffin and fashion icon Isaac Mizrahi.

RuPaul provides running commentary and fun facts while the queens star in a mystery behind-the-scenes reenactment series. Pop sensation Ariana Grande and former Drag Race panelist Merle Ginsberg guest judge.

RuPaul provides running commentary and fun facts while the queens impersonate celebrities in a bawdy quick-witted TV game show. With guest judges Tamar Braxton (Tamar & Vince) and Michael Urie (Ugly Betty).
Ten All Stars compete for $100,000 and a place in the Drag Race Hall of Fame! Their first challenge is a salute to LGBTQ troops in an All Star-Spangled Variety Show!

The All Stars audition for a new supergroup, 'Henny!' and must write lyrics and perform epic choreographed numbers, featuring Drag Race legend, Stacy Layne Matthews. Extra special guest judges Kacey Musgraves and Ciara.

The All Stars compete in The Snatch Game, but with a romantic twist! The Super Queens impersonate celebrities to win the hearts of hunky bachelors. Extra special guest judges: Olympian Gus Kenworthy and Keiynan Lonsdale ('Love Simon').

In a salute to all things Jersey, the All Stars plead their cases before 'Judge' Michelle Visage in an unscripted courtroom parody. Extra special guest judges: Zoe Kravitz and comedian Erica Ash.
The All Stars compete in a comedy roast and must write and perform a 'Rulogy' for a drag legend, Lady Bunny. Extra special guest judges: SNL's Cecily Strong and Yvette Nicole Brown.

For the first time in Drag Race Herstory, all of the eliminated All Stars get a chance to return to the competition. But first they have to send home a competing All Star in a shocking midseason lip sync smackdown.
The All Stars are challenged to design and host their own VIP club nights. Extra special guest judges: Rita Ora and NYC Nightlife legend Susanne Bartsch.
The All Stars pay tribute to the legend, Judy Garland, as they transform their best friends into members of their own drag family! Extra special guest judges: Francis Bean Cobain and Ellen Pompeo.
